BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to deterring robberies from retail establishments; and amending RCW 9.94A.832.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 9.94A.832 and 2013 c 270 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Special allegation—Robbery in the first or second degree—Robbery of a pharmacy—Procedures.
BillSection.P: (1) The the defendant has been convicted of robbery in the first degree or robbery in the second degree; and
(2) There there has been a special allegation pleaded and proven beyond a reasonable doubt that the defendant committed a robbery of a:
(1) A pharmacy as defined in RCW 18.64.011(21); or

P.TextRun: (2) A retail outlet and the defendant committed the robbery by using a vehicle to damage or gain access to the retail outlet; or
(3) A retail outlet and the defendant committed the robbery in concert with another individual or individuals;

BillSection.P: the court shall make a finding of fact of the special allegation, or if a jury is had, the jury shall, if it finds the defendant guilty, also find a special verdict as to the special allegation.

RevNote.NoteP: *Reviser's note: RCW 18.64.011 was alphabetized pursuant to RCW 1.08.015(2)(k), changing subsection (21) to subsection (26).
